teaser.en: Touch a leaf and it folds shut and droops; Digo people recognise it by exactly this habit.
teaser.sw: Gusa jani nalo hujifunga na kulegea; Wadigo huutambua mmea huu kwa tabia hiyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Uchiguta kodza, rinadzikundza na kugbwadzika photsi; Adigo anaumanya mmea uhu kpwa tabiya ihi hasa.

summary.en: Mbodzebodze is the sensitive plant, a prickly weed whose leaves fold up and droop at a touch. Digo people group it with Biophytum, another 'resurrection plant' with the same habit.
summary.sw: Mbodzebodze ni kifauongo, gugu lenye miiba ambalo majani yake hujikunja na kulegea likiguswa. Wadigo huuweka pamoja na Biophytum, 'mmea mwingine wa kufufuka' wenye tabia hiyohiyo.
summary.dg: *Mbodzebodze* ni mbondo yenye miya, ambayo makodzage ganadzikundza na kugbwadzika uchigaguta. Adigo anauika phamwenga na *Biophytum*, mmea wanjina 'unaofufuka' wenye tabiya iyo iyo.

about.en: Mbodzebodze is a sprawling, prickly herb or low shrub. Its leaves are divided into many pairs of tiny leaflets. When touched, shaken or warmed, the leaflets fold together in pairs and the whole leaf droops. A few minutes later it slowly opens again. The leaves also close at night. The flowers are fluffy pink pom-poms about the size of a marble. They are followed by small, flat, bristly pods that break into one-seeded segments.
about.sw: Mbodzebodze ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kifupi chenye miiba kinachotanda. Majani yake yamegawanyika kuwa jozi nyingi za vijani vidogo sana. Yakiguswa, yakitikiswa au yakipata joto, vijani hujikunja jozi kwa jozi na jani zima hulegea. Baada ya dakika chache hufunguka tena polepole. Majani pia hujifunga usiku. Maua ni vishungi laini vya waridi vya mviringo, vyenye ukubwa wa gololi. Hufuatwa na maganda madogo bapa yenye vinywele vigumu, yanayokatika kuwa vipande vyenye mbegu moja moja.
about.dg: *Mbodzebodze* ni mmea au chitsaka chifupi chinachotandazika, chenye miya. Makodzage ganaganywa kukala jozi nyinji za makodza madide sana. Uchigaguta, gachisumba au gachiphaha dzoho, makodza madide ganadzikundza jozi-jozi, na kodza rosi rinagbwadzika. Bada ya dakika chache, rinavuguka tsona pore-pore. Makodza piya ganadzikundza usiku. Maruwa ni ga pinki, ga nyere-nyere dza mipira midide, ga ukulu wa gololi. Badaye kunazuka makakaya madide, bapa, genye nyere ngumu, ganayovundzika kukala vipande vya tembe mwenga mwenga.

where.en: Originally from tropical America, it is now a common weed in warm countries, growing in fallow fields, lawns, roadsides and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika ya kitropiki, lakini sasa ni gugu la kawaida katika nchi zenye joto, likiota kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa, nyasi za bustani, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa.
where.dg: Kare waphahikana Amerika ya tsi za dzoho tu, ela sambi ni mbondo ya kawaida kpwenye tsi za dzoho, inayomera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, nyasi za kaya, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu tsi iriphobanangwa.

culture.en: Pakia notes that the Digo identify this plant mainly by its behaviour: its leaves close on touch. He found touch to be one of the main ways people confirm the identity of plants with leaves like these. *Mbodzembodze* is a collective term for such 'resurrection plants', covering both *Biophytum petersianum* and *Mimosa pudica*. Elsewhere Pakia records the Digo expression *kuvwala nguo*, 'to dress', for a plant closing its leaves when touched.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua mmea huu hasa kwa tabia yake: majani yake hujifunga yakiguswa. Aligundua kwamba kugusa ni mojawapo ya njia kuu ambazo watu huthibitisha utambulisho wa mimea yenye majani kama haya. *Mbodzembodze* ni jina la jumla la 'mimea ya kufufuka' kama hii, likijumuisha *Biophytum petersianum* na *Mimosa pudica*. Kwingineko Pakia anarekodi msemo wa Kidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvaa nguo', kwa mmea unaojifunga majani ukiguswa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya mmea uhu hasa kpwa tabiyaye: makodzage ganadzikundza uchigaguta. Pakia waona kukala kuguta ni kahi ya njira kulu ambazo atu nkuhumira kumanya sawa-sawa mimea yenye makodza dza higa. *Mbodzembodze* ni dzina ra jumla ra mimea hino 'inayofufuka', na rinahumirwa kpwa *Biophytum petersianum* na *Mimosa pudica* zosi mbiri. Phatu phanjina Pakia anaandika maneno ga Chidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvwala nguwo', kpwa mmea unaodzikundza makodzage uchigutwa.

names.en: Digo: *mbodzebodze*. Pakia's list spells it slightly differently from *mbodzembodze* (*Biophytum*), but in his main text he treats the two as one name for leaf-folding plants. No meaning is given. In English it is the sensitive plant or touch-me-not.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbodzebodze*. Orodha ya Pakia inaliandika tofauti kidogo na *mbodzembodze* (*Biophytum*), lakini katika maandishi yake makuu analichukulia kuwa jina moja la mimea inayojikunja majani. Hakuna maana iliyotolewa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sensitive plant* au *touch-me-not*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbodzebodze*. Kahi ya madzina Pakia anayoganandika, dzina hiri rinaandikpwa tafwauti chidide na *mbodzembodze* (*Biophytum*), ela kpwenye kaziye Pakia anagaona dza dzina mwenga ra mimea inayokundza makodza. Kaandika manage. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sensitive plant* au *touch-me-not*.

reason.en: Sicklebush, a relative with similar pom-pom flowers
reason.sw: Mpangwa (sicklebush), ndugu wenye maua ya vishungi vinavyofanana
reason.dg: *Mchinjiri*, ndugu wenye maruwa dza mipira midide ya nyere

reason.en: Blackjack, another common weed of disturbed ground
reason.sw: Kishonanguo, gugu jingine la kawaida la ardhi iliyovurugwa
reason.dg: *Todza*, mbondo yanjina ya kawaida ya phatu tsi iriphobanangwa
